title: Grateful Dead Live at Giants Stadium on 1991-06-17
lineage: MAD > Sony TCD-D10P > Coax SPDIF > Audiophile 2496 > Soundforge (at 48kHz) > CD-Wave > R8Brain v1.9 (downsample to 44.1kHz) > TLH > FLAC.
source: Nakamichi CM-300's w/CP-4 shotgun capsules > Casio DA-7 > Maxell R-DM Dat tape. Mics on stand aprx 8-feet high, set up to the left of the soundboard (stage right).

ai_review.summary: Deep, immersive audience recording captures a jam‑heavy 1991 show with standout "Eyes", "Loose Lucy" and a scorching Truckin’/New Speedway Boogies sequence.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its nonstop improvisational energy, highlighted by an electrifying opener (Eyes), a rocking Loose Lucy, and what many call the best Truckin' → New Speedway Boogies jam of the era. The audience recording supplied by Andrew F delivers a vivid sense of venue ambience, though listeners note it could use a touch more volume.

ai_rating.rationale: Three enthusiastic reviews (two 4‑star and one highly positive despite a 0 rating) praise the show’s improvisation and specific songs, while noting only minor volume issues in an audience source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, deep venue ambience that feels real; a slight overall low‑volume level is mentioned but no major distortion or dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert flows as a continuous jam session, with improvisational peaks (Dark Star/Other One tease) that keep the energy high from opener through the extended Truckin' sequence.

band_member_comments.Phil: Several reviewers spotlight Phil’s bass work, noting his crucial role in the jam leading up to the Eleven‑style tease.
